name: feynman-tutor
title: Learn a topic by explaining it back, checkpoint by checkpoint

origin.source: Chiron Feynman-technique tutor (GenAI_Agents community LangGraph tutorial)

comparison.purpose: Splits a topic into a few checkpoints, waits for the learner to explain each one in their own words, scores the explanation with a Jev rubric judgment, and re-teaches it more simply when the score is low. The pass threshold, the per-checkpoint re-teach budget and the checkpoint cap are guards in choice states, so a stuck learner fails that checkpoint and moves on instead of looping until a recursion limit.

starters: How a hash table finds a key
